newsitem.title: USA: Hudson meat recall among largest in U.S. -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Hudson meat recall among largest in U.S. -- USDA.

text.p: The recall of 1.2 million pounds of hamburger produced by Hudson Foods Inc is one of the largest on record, U.S. Agriculture Department officials said Friday.
Press secretary Tom Amontree said the hamburger recall might be the second-largest ever. However, officials said they did not have at hand a list of all major recalls.
Officials said they know of at least one larger recall, involving turkey meat in 1995.
